status.description: The status of the job run.

sourceRunCounts.description:
The number of {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.SourceRun} (each corresponding to a single source file)
that are in the given status.

processorChunkCount.description: The total number of chunks produced by the {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job#processor} for this run.

vectorCount.description: The total number of vectors stored in the {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job#vectorStore} for this run.

errorCount.description: Count of any errors which occurred during the run.

startTime.description:
The time when the run started. If the run was {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.Run#retry}[retried], this refers
to the time when the most recent retry started.

endTime.description:
If the run has finished, the time when it ended. If the run was
{@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.Run#retry}[retried], this refers to the time when the most recent retry ended.

duration.description:
The duration of the run. If the run was {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Job.Run#retry}[retried], this refers to the
duration of the most recent retry.

If the run is still in progress, this will be the duration from #startTime to the current time.
If the run has completed, this will be the duration from #startTime to #endTime.

componentLevelSummary.description:
Summary of the latest run categorized by component and mapped to aggregated metrics per batch of files.
Time metrics are in milliseconds.
